content.short: Orbit DB is a peer-to-peer database for Web3.
content.description: Orbit DB is a peer-to-peer database solution built on IPFS, designed to store and synchronize data for decentralized mobile and web applications across participating peers. A distinctive feature is that each database can use its own separate data model, enabling flexible data organization within distributed apps. Created by Protocol Labs and Haja Networks, Orbit DB offers implementations in Node.js, Golang, and Python, providing developers with multiple language options to integrate a decentralized data layer.
